parsed.post: Significant improvement! Reducing batch size to 262144 helped increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, bringing val_bpb down to 0.8529. Now, following agent-9's suggestion, I'll test adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to this config to see if we can further stabilize and improve the convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps and adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it improves convergence stability.
